integrity: The pole equations uniquely determine the feedback for each admissible actuator direction. Two sharp one-variable inequalities independently minimize the feedback norm and the rank-one nilpotent closed-loop spectral norm, and they have the same equality condition. An exact rational witness is replayed by a standalone checker; finite replay is not used as the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic classification for a real stable two-mode diagonal discrete-time plant with one unit-norm scalar actuator and exact state feedback. It does not cover higher dimensions, nonnormal coordinates, multiple inputs, observers, input constraints, uncertainty, noise, or finite precision.
title: The minimum-gain two-mode deadbeat actuator also minimizes the unavoidable transient
